. ३५: IV. २३. १२: X. ४१. ३२: ४७. ४०: ५२. ४०: ५९. १०: XI. ३०. १६.
who was stationed at the western gate of मथुरा for defence.
2: Ib. X. ५०. २० [4].
Had a place on the left detachment of कृष्ण's army. When जरासन्ध attacked मथुरा for a third time, Gada played a heroic part.
3: Ib. [५० (V) ११]: [५१ (V) २५].
Attacked Caidya party which pursued कृष्ण taking away रुक्मिणी.
4: Ib. ५४. 6.
Went with वृष्णिस् to the city of बाण.
5: Ib. ६३. 3.
Accompanied साम्ब and others to play and came across a huge lizard in a well and reported it to कृष्ण.
6: Ib. ६४. १२ [1-4].
Took part in defending द्वारका against शाल्व and in expelling his forces.
7: Ib. X. ७६. १४: ७७. 4.
Went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for solar eclipse.
8: Ib. ८२. 6.
At प्रभास.
9: Ib. XI. ३०. १६.
(II)--a son of Vasudeva and रोहिणी. भा. IX. २४. ४६. [page१-509+ २७]
(III)--a son of Vasudeva and देवरक्षिता. भा. IX. २४. ५२.

(IV)--Art and science of, learnt by Duryodhana from बलराम;
1: भा. X. ५७. २६: Br. III. ७१. ८४.
a war weapon.
2: M. १४०. १४.
(V)--an Asura, stronger than वज्रायुध, gave his bone to ब्रह्मा on the latter's request; विश्वकर्मन् made it a gada. वा. १०९. 3-4.
(VI)--a son of भद्रा and Vasudeva. Vi. IV. १५. २४.

--विष्णु as; the first narrator of the Matsya पुराण; in the तारकामय war;
1:

. १०: १७६. ३०: १७८. २३ and ४६ Va1. १०६. ५५.
boon to Dharmavrata after she became a stone.
2: वा. ६०. ७७: १०७. ४७: १०८. ५२: १०९. १२, २०.
--a महातीर्थ where Hari got the गदा cleaned after breaking Heti's head with it. वा. १११. ७५-6. [page१-510+ २४]
